_comment: GENERATED — maps each file under dune/celo-chain/ to its Dune query id. /api/cron/dune-refresh imports dependentQueryIds to know what to re-run daily. That list is only the queries WITH A PANEL on the dashboard: 14_by_service and 15_by_contract are hidden on Dune (is_temp) and appear in `queries` below but never in dependentQueryIds. 12_by_rail is NOT retired here (unlike the Base dashboard) — it is the headline metric for this dashboard, so it stays live. Safe to hand-edit only when the queries were created manually on dune.com; otherwise regenerate via scripts/dune-celo-setup.mjs.
